title: 011 温玉妙用012 九阳神符
content_zh:
：管明晦料定，以杨鲤刚烈倔强的性格，在得知有温玉能够克制自己的情况下，绝不会就此一走了之。
虽然有赌的成分，但结局从一开始就已经注定。
他拿着温玉，得意地笑着：“你只知道我是旁门左道，所炼阴阳偏落一门，阴被阳克，合情合理。
却不知道，我这里也讲究阴尽阳生，阳尽阴生，真阴真阳相互转化，与你所学应该没什么不同。
只是我这另有玄阴玄阳一显一隐之奥妙，别说是你，就算你师父来了，我给他讲他也听不明白！”
杨鲤脸上的表情从开始的错愕震惊，迅速转为愤怒和懊悔，心里面暗骂自己：左道邪魔皆是毫无信义的卑劣之人，他们说出来的话如何能够相信！
管明晦端着温玉，美美地打量：“我老人家会的法术比这莽苍山的花草树木加起来还多，传给你的只不过是几片叶子。
你对我心存不屑，看不起这种旁门左道之术。
我劝你以后还是收起心中的傲慢，尊重我些，多学几手，够你终生受用不尽。”
杨鲤听他贬低自己师父，心中很是不爽，但也没有立即反驳，因为知道没意义，只是默默地退回墙角。
管明晦越说越得意：“长眉老儿都杀不死我，你个只有一口宝剑傍身的半大孩子，还做这斩妖除魔的美梦，简直是要想瞎了心！
不说别的，长眉老儿特地给我选了这处绝地，利用地肺吹万，日用天罡，夜用地煞，不断地打磨我的形神，要让我魂飞魄散。
我却在地肺里安置了九阴神符，在那上面用了九阳神符，将天罡地煞过滤驯服，不但不能伤我，还能为所用，助我炼制神幡！”
杨鲤越听越绝望，越听越伤心，不想看他得意的样子，就转回身，面对墙壁盘膝而坐，默默运功修炼。
管明晦把该说的话都说完了，也不再聒噪，把注意力都放在温玉上面。
这宝贝名叫万年温玉，实际上从形成到如今所经历的时间何止万年！
其为莽苍山龙脉阳气孕育而成，偏又不燥不热，温润无比，其性质并非太阳，而是少阳，最为珍贵。
原著中谷辰用它温养自己的肉身，尤其被长眉真人预留神符炸翻以后，用它快速修复自己的肉身。
后来被李英琼所得，李英琼用它寄托元神，修炼出身外化身。
得亏有杨鲤这傻小子相助，自己提前了八九十年将它拿到，不但身体能够更快恢复，以后还可用它寄托三尸元神，修炼三尸化身！

管明晦用四转的黑眚丝织成一个网兜，把这玉包裹起来，挂在胸口。
白日里，罡风下坠，管明晦用它去收风中的太阳精气，此为“少阳胜老阳”
“小圣伏大圣”
之法。
等到了晚上，地煞疾吹，管明晦用它释放阳气，宛如温泉热水将全身充满，全身热乎乎的，舒服无比！
原本即便有玄阴幡抵挡守护，由于幡的威力还不够大，仍然有大半罡煞吹到身上，只能运功硬抗。
如今罡煞威力全被这温玉所伏，再无半点损害。
温玉还能帮助他冰冷僵硬的下半身迅速回暖，少阳之气熏蒸筋骨肉皮，枯死的经脉被迅速打通。
太阴炼形会把人炼成僵尸，其中一个最主要的原因就是阴气太盛，气血凝滞，一念用错就要走火入魔。
走火是身体上气血运行出错，火候，指修炼内丹时的下手功夫，如同炒菜，火候太嫩，菜没熟，火候太过，菜就烧糊了。
这个火候，最难把握，必须得恰到好处。
而入魔，是心性上的功夫，入了幻觉，认假为真。
温玉不能解决入魔问题，但基本可以百分之百防治走火。
哪怕火候没掌握对，菜烧坏了，倒掉重烧就是了，不会炉塌鼎崩，毁了肉身。
蜀山里走火坐僵的人多得是，比如哈哈老祖，百禽道人，五毒天王，邓八姑等等，年深日久，下半身跟石头长在一起。
content_en:
: Guan Minghui knew that with Yang Li's strong and stubborn character, he would never just walk away when he learned that Wen Yu could restrain him.
Although there was an element of gambling, the outcome was doomed from the beginning.
He held the warm jade and smiled proudly: "You only know that I am a heretic, and the yin and yang I cultivate fall into one category, and the yin is overcome by the yang. It is reasonable and reasonable.
But I don’t know that here I also pay attention to the yin and yang, yang and yin, and the mutual transformation of true yin and true yang. It should be no different from what you have learned.
It's just that I still have the mystery of Xuanyin and Xuanyang appearing and disappearing. Let alone you, even if your master comes, he won't understand if I tell him! "
The expression on Yang Li's face changed from the initial shock to anger and remorse. He cursed himself in his heart: The devils are all dishonest and despicable people. How can you believe what they say!
Guan Minghui held Wen Yu and looked at it beautifully: "My old man knows more spells than the flowers, plants and trees in Mangcang Mountain combined, and what I have passed on to you is just a few leaves.
You are disdainful of me and look down upon this heresy.
I advise you to put away your arrogance in the future, respect me more, and learn more skills, which will be enough for you to use throughout your life. "
Yang Li felt very unhappy when he heard him belittle his master, but he did not immediately refute because he knew it was pointless, so he just silently retreated to the corner.
The more Guan Minghui talked, the more proud he became: "Even the old man with long eyebrows can't kill me. You, a half-grown child with only a sword at your side, still have this dream of slaying demons, you are just going crazy!"
Not to mention anything else, the old man with long eyebrows specially chose this place for me. He used the earth's lungs to blow the wind, the sky's power during the day, and the earth's evil at night, to constantly polish my body and soul, and to make my soul fly away.
But I placed the Nine Yin Talisman in the lungs of the earth, and used the Nine Yang Talisman on it to filter and tame the Tiangang Earth Evil. Not only can it not hurt me, but it can also be used to help me refine the divine banner! "
The more Yang Li listened, the more desperate and sad he became. Not wanting to see him look proud, he turned around, sat cross-legged facing the wall, and practiced silently.
Guan Minghui finished what he needed to say and stopped making any noise, focusing all his attention on Wen Yu.
This treasure is called Wannian Wenyu. In fact, the time it has taken from its formation to the present is more than ten thousand years!
It is bred from the yang energy of the dragon veins of Mangcang Mountain. It is neither dry nor hot, but extremely warm and moist. Its nature is not the sun, but Shaoyang, which is the most precious.
In the original work, Gu Chen uses it to warm his body, especially after being blown up by the magic talisman reserved by the real person Changmei, he uses it to quickly repair his body.
Later, it was acquired by Li Yingqiong, who used it to entrust the soul and cultivate the incarnation outside the body.
Thanks to the help of a silly boy like Yang Li, I got it eighty or ninety years in advance. Not only can my body recover faster, but I can also use it to entrust the soul of the three corpses in the future and cultivate the incarnation of the three corpses!
Guan Minghui weaved four turns of black silk into a net bag, wrapped the jade and hung it on his chest.
During the day, when the strong wind falls, Guan Minghui uses it to collect the sun essence in the wind. This is "the young sun beats the old sun"
"The Little Saint and the Great Saint"
method.
At night, when the evil spirit blows from the ground, Guan Minghui uses it to release Yang Qi, just like the hot spring water filling the whole body. The whole body is warm and comfortable!
Originally, even if there were Xuanyin flags to resist the protection, because the power of the flags was not strong enough, most of the Gangsha was still blown onto the body, so he could only use his power to resist.
Now the power of Gangsha has been subdued by this warm jade, and there is no more damage at all.
Warm jade can also help his cold and stiff lower body to quickly warm up. The Shaoyang energy fumigates the muscles, bones, flesh and skin, and the dead meridians are quickly opened.
Taiyin refining can turn people into zombies. One of the main reasons is that the yin energy is too strong and the qi and blood are stagnant. If you use the wrong thought, you will go crazy.
Fire failure is an error in the movement of Qi and blood in the body. Heat refers to the initial effort when practicing inner alchemy. It is like cooking. If the heat is too tender, the vegetables will not be cooked. If the heat is too high, the vegetables will not be cooked.It was burnt.
This heat is the most difficult to control and must be just right.
Being possessed by a demon is a work of mind, falling into hallucinations and believing falsehoods to be true.
Wen Yu cannot solve the problem of being possessed, but it can basically prevent and cure fire attacks 100%.
Even if the heat is not controlled correctly and the dishes are burnt, just throw them out and re-burn them. The furnace will not collapse and the body will be destroyed.
There are many people in Shushan who are stuck in the fire, such as Patriarch Haha, Taoist Baiqin, Five Poison Heavenly Kings, Deng Bagu, etc. Over time, their lower bodies have grown together with stones.
